source_landscape: Thin on the specific figure. Well documented that London's deep-level tube lines were electric from their opening (City & South London Railway, 1890, the world's first deep-level electric tube) and that sub-surface lines (Metropolitan, District) were electrified around 1905 — but no accessible source states the exact number of steam locomotives still in service on the Underground in 1905. Expect honest low-confidence reporting, not a confident count.
